nom: Saudiya Arabistoni ta'lim vazirligi stipendiyasi (Study in Saudi)

nimani_qoplaydi.qiymat: To'liq (bepul) stipendiyada: o'qish to'lovisiz ta'lim, tibbiy yordam, kelganda bir martalik pul mukofoti, yotoqxona, yillik aviachipta
nimani_qoplaydi.manba_iborasi: free of charge and without tuition fees

deadline.qiymat: Har yili universitetlar o'quv yili talablariga qarab belgilaydi (yagona sana yo'q)
deadline.manba_iborasi: The opening date for the scholarship application program is determined according to the requirements of the academic year at universities.

toliq_qoplaydi.manba_iborasi: free scholarships in which the student gets full benefits

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Fuqarolik: Saudiya Arabistonidan tashqarida yashovchi chet ellik talabalar uchun "tashqi stipendiya" (dunyoning barcha davlatlaridan)
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: External scholarships for non-Saudi students from outside the Kingdom.

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Fuqarolik: Saudiya Arabistoni hamma xalqaro talabalarga istalgan universitetiga topshirish imkonini beradi
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is giving an opportunity to all international students to apply at any

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Yosh: bakalavr uchun 17 yoshdan kichik va 25 yoshdan katta bo'lmasligi kerak
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: should not be less than (17) years old and not more than (25) years for the undergraduate

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Ta'lim darajasi: arab tili diplomi, bakalavr, magistr va doktorantura; sog'liqni saqlash va tibbiyot yo'nalishlaridan tashqari hamma yo'nalishlar
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: except for health and medical specialties

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Qabul talablari: saudiyalik talabalarga qo'yiladigan qabul talablari stipendiyachilarga ham qo'llanadi
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: The admission requirements applicable to Saudis in institutions of higher education apply to internal and external scholarship students.

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Davlat roziligi: talaba davlati talab qilsa, o'sha davlat hukumati Saudiyada o'qishga rozilik berishi kerak
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: That the government of the student’s country approves the study in the Kingdom for countries that require it

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Oldingi stipendiya: Saudiyadagi boshqa ta'lim muassasasidan avval stipendiya olmagan bo'lishi kerak
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: The student should not have obtained another scholarship from an educational institution in the Kingdom.

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Chetlatilmagan: Saudiyadagi ta'lim muassasalaridan chetlatilmagan bo'lishi kerak
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: He should not be dismissed from one of the educational institutions in the Kingdom

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Sog'liq: qoidalarda belgilangan tibbiy ko'rikdan o'tishi kerak
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: To pass the medical examination determined by the regulations and instructions.

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Mahram: tegishli ko'rsatmalarga ko'ra talaba bilan mahram bo'lishi talab qilinadi (rasmiy matndagi shart)
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: That he has a mahram with the student, according to the instructions regulating that

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Til: nazariy yo'nalishlar arab tilida, amaliy yo'nalishlar ingliz tilida o'qitiladi
Joylar: har universitetda stipendiyachilar uchun joylarning 5 foizi ajratiladi, Madina Islom universitetida 85 foiz
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: The percentage allocated for scholarship students to each university is 5%, except for the Islamic

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: Stipendiya turi: to'liq (bepul) stipendiyada talaba hamma imtiyozlarni oladi; qisman stipendiyada faqat ba'zilari (masalan, faqat o'rin yoki o'rin va yotoqxona)
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: free scholarships in which the student gets full benefits

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: O'qish to'lovi: stipendiyachilar bepul, o'qish to'lovisiz o'qiydi
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: free of charge and without tuition fees

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: Sug'urta: talaba (va qoidalar ruxsat bersa, birga yashaydigan oila a'zolari) uchun tibbiy yordam
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: Health care for him and his family members if they are brought in to reside with him

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: Stipendiya: Saudiyaga kelganda bir martalik pul mukofoti
Aviachipta: qoidalarga muvofiq har yili yo'l chiptasi
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: Annual travel tickets, taking into account the regulations

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: Boshqa: universitetning boshqa talabalari foydalanadigan imtiyozlar
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: The advantages enjoyed by fellow students of the educational institution.

hujjatlar.qiymat: Sertifikat va hujjatlar: universitet belgilagan vakolatli organlarda tasdiqlangan (attestatsiya) bo'lishi kerak
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: To attest certificates and supporting papers from the competent authorities specified by the educational institution.

hujjatlar.qiymat: Sudlanmaganlik haqida ma'lumotnoma: o'z davlatining xavfsizlik organlaridan
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: To present a certificate of absence of precedents from the security services in his country.

hujjatlar.qiymat: Tavsiyanoma: universitet belgilagan tashkilot yoki shaxsdan talab qilinishi mumkin
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: The educational institution may require a student’s recommendation

hujjatlar.qiymat: Davlat roziligi: talab qiladigan davlatlar uchun hukumatning o'qishga roziligi
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: That the government of the student’s country approves the study in the Kingdom for countries that require it

tavsif.qiymat: Ariza tanlangan davlat universitetining sayti orqali beriladi; har universitetning o'z shartlari bor
tavsif.manba_iborasi: you can apply by entering the website of the university you want to apply for to study

sana.qiymat: Har universitet o'quv yili talablariga qarab belgilaydi
sana.manba_iborasi: The opening date for the scholarship application program is determined according to the requirements of the academic year at universities.

tavsif.qiymat: O'z davlatingizdagi Saudiya madaniy attashesiga, u bo'lmasa Saudiya elchixonasiga murojaat qilinadi
tavsif.manba_iborasi: If there is no Saudi cultural attaché in your country, one can apply to the Embassy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

tavsif.qiymat: O'qish vizasi uchun Saudiya universitetidan stipendiya olingan bo'lishi kerak
tavsif.manba_iborasi: To obtain a study visa from Saudi embassies, applicants must have a scholarship from a Saudi university.

tavsif.qiymat: Kelgach, universitet xati bilan o'qish davriga bepul yashash ruxsatnomasi olinadi
tavsif.manba_iborasi: the scholarship recipients may obtain a free residence permit for the duration of their study

ariza_yoli.qiymat: Ariza "Study in Saudi" portali orqali, tanlangan davlat universitetiga beriladi; vazirlik sahifasi o'z davlatingizdagi Saudiya madaniy attashesi yoki elchixonasiga murojaat qilishni ham aytadi
ariza_yoli.manba_iborasi: Applications must be submitted through the “Study in Saudi”
